messages:
Maria G: Quick sync — proposing we call the new short-lived tokens "microgrants". Purpose: replace most internal service long-lived API keys and narrow scopes. Thoughts?
Dan H: +1 on name. Concern: issuer scale and latency for hot paths.
Olivia P: If we mint per-request, adds ~2-20ms depending on cache. Need numbers.
Kevin L: Sidecar cache pattern: cache microgrant per resource prefix, TTL ~10s. Avoids mint on every call.
Maria G: Yes. Audience-bound tokens with minimal privileges; sidecars/SDKs cache.
Dan H: Revocation: epoch-based invalidation? bump epoch to revoke older tokens.
Olivia P: Epoch check + issued_at is cheap. For urgent revocations, small blacklist for nonces.
Kevin L: Audit volume up. Suggest sampling issuance logs and full dump on anomalies.
Maria G: Include origin service id, request id, trace_id in metadata for debugging.
Dan H: Token format: signed compact JWT vs opaque reference. Tradeoffs: JWT fast verify, harder to revoke.
Olivia P: Hybrid: compact signed token with nonce; verify signature + epoch; blacklist high-risk nonces.
Kevin L: Keep tokens small (<1600 bytes) for gRPC metadata limits.
Maria G: Offer two verification modes: sidecar cached pubkey verify, central gateway full checks.
Dan H: Sidecar verification eases rollout.
Olivia P: Key rotation plan: issuer rotates weekly, publishes kids; sidecars refresh every minute. Use KMS and config push.
Kevin L: RBAC: microgrants reference role_ids, not inline permissions. Central policy mapping remains.
Maria G: Microgrant shape: principal, role_id, resource_audience, ttl, nonce. Issuer enforces role->perm mapping.
Dan H: Backcompat: accept legacy project-scoped keys during deprecation; detect misuse.
Olivia P: SDKs provide adapter to mint and cache tokens; app code uses get_token() or middleware.
Kevin L: Prototype candidates: autoscaler metadata and metrics ingestion. Pilot 2 weeks, measure latency, mint rate, cache hit ratio, audit growth.
Maria G: Action items: Maria draft mini-RFC (token format + epoch revocation); Olivia sketch SDK flow + TTL options; Kevin design sidecar cache + throughput.
Olivia P: ACK.
Kevin L: ACK.
Dan H: ACK.
security-bot: Runbook: <https://intranet.redwood/ops/runbooks/microgrants>. Follow incident process if auth latency spikes.
